messages.content: Write the About page for a company that makes scheduling software for medical clinics. Around 250 words.

output:
Company name and the founding details are placeholders — swap in your real ones (marked in brackets).

---

## About [Northline]

Anyone who has worked a clinic front desk knows the sound. The phone ringing while two people wait at the counter, a fax machine coughing up a referral, and the 9:15 still sitting in her car because nobody told her the doctor was running late.

[Northline] was started in [2019] by [a former practice manager and two engineers] who got tired of watching good clinics lose an hour a day to that noise. We build scheduling software for medical practices — the kind with four exam rooms and one person doing intake, billing, and reminders at the same time.

What that means in practice: patients book online without calling, reminders go out by text, and cancellations get backfilled from a waitlist automatically instead of leaving a room dark for forty minutes. Providers see one calendar. It syncs with [your EHR], because we think a scheduling tool that makes you type the appointment twice isn't worth installing.

We have opinions about this. Software should not need a three-day training. If your staff can't run a full day of scheduling after one morning with us, that's our failure, not theirs — so onboarding is included, and a real person answers support.

Today [about 900] clinics across [12 states] run their day on [Northline], from solo dermatology practices to community health centers with sixty providers. HIPAA compliance and a signed BAA come standard.

The front desk deserves a quieter morning. That's the whole idea.

---

~250 words. Want a shorter version, or one aimed at enterprise health systems rather than small practices?
